# 1. Peaceful Reform: Establish Imperial Service Nobility (和平改制：将豪强私兵转为帝国服役贵族)
oe_van_v97_dec_mod_service_nobility = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        current_year >= 1537
        is_subject = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
            current_year >= 1550
        }
        OR = {
            has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_noble_rule_area
            has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_noble_household_retinue
        }
        NOT = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_van_v97_priv_imperial_service_nobility }
    }
    allow = {
        current_year >= 1537
        at_war = no
        stability >= 10
        government_power >= 60
        estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate >= 0.50
        gold >= 150
        OR = {
            current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
            current_year >= 1550
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_van_v97_dec_mod_service_nobility.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -150
            unlock_estate_privilege_effect = { type = oe_van_v97_priv_imperial_service_nobility }
            if = {
                limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_noble_rule_area }
                revoke_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_noble_rule_area
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_noble_household_retinue }
                revoke_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_noble_household_retinue
            }
            grant_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_van_v97_priv_imperial_service_nobility
            add_stability = 3
            add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus }
            oe_van_v97_maybe_fire_charter_milestone = yes
        }
    }
}
